The device list: an icon for the form factor, the name, platform and last seen, This device, an inline rename, and Remove with an inline confirm. In browser mode it links to the portal's device page instead.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-python" />

    **Drop-in.** `devices` (`list`, `rename <id> <label>`, `deauthorize <id>` with a y/N confirm, `--yes` in scripts).

    **Styled part.** `screens.devices(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `DevicesView`, `DeviceRow` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-node" />

    **Drop-in.** `devices list` (`devicesListFlow`): this device first and marked, each with its
    platform and id (`list`, `empty`); `devices rename <deviceId> [label...]` and
    `devices deauthorize <deviceId>`.

    **Styled part.** Rail rows with the radio symbols (`●` this device, `○` the others), the id kept
    whole.

    **Headless.** `devicesView(devices)`: `list` or `empty`, with each row's `name`, `platform`,
    `current` and `lastSeenAt`.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    **Drop-in.** A section a host drops into its settings.

    **Styled part.** `DevicesSection(screen:devices:onRemove:onRetry:onManage:)` with `DeviceRow`; Remove is a swipe action, confirmed before it signs the device out.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.devices(_:)`: `This device` only for a row the runtime knows is this device.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
